Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Manufacturer / Authorized Dealer Requirement The Bidder/OEM must be a reputed manufacturer or an a uthorized dealer for all types of furniture items. The OEM must have its own furniture manufacturing facilit y in India for a minimum period of 10 years. The following documentary proofs must be enclosed with the bid: Factory License • EPF Registration Certificate • ESIC Registration Certificate • Trademark Certificate f or Brand Name • Memorandum of Association (MOA) / Incorporation Certificate 2. ISO Certifications The Bidder/OEM must possess the following valid certifications issued by NABCB-accre dited certification bodies: •ISO 9001: 2015 • ISO 14001: 2015 • ISO 45001: 2018 • ISO 50001: 2018 Copie s of valid certificates must be enclosed with the bid. 3. BIFMA Membership The Bidder/OEM must have continuous membership of the BIFMA for at least the last 2 years. Copies of membership certificates along with confirmation from the official website BIFMA must b e enclosed. 4. BIFMA Compliant Registry The Bidder/OEM must have a minimum of More than Two furniture product list ed under the BIFMA Compliant Registry. A screenshot/printout from the official BIFMA website showing the listed product must be enclosed with the bid. 5. AIOTA Certification The Bidder/OEM must possess a valid certificate issued by the All-India Occupational Therapists’ Association (AIOTA) for: Educational Furniture, Storage System, Office Furniture including Seati ng Systems Copy . 5.
